entry.title: Northgard v2026.8.4
entry.content:
### Fixed - Stale Chapter-unlock markers left over from a previous Conquest save or room could falsely unlock an unrelated node in a brand-new save whenever Northgard's random battle-name pool reused the same name (e.g. a fresh save's Chapter 06 - Top could appear unlocked before ever being earned). entry.title: Refunct v1.3.0
entry.content:
## Co-op! - In the yaml and in in-game settings, you can enable seeing other players. If other players in the multiworld have this setting on too, you can see them walking around in your game! - The option is called "see other players" and it determines how many other players you can see in your game. Setting it to 0 turns it off. I think 10 players at a time should be fine performance-wise. - (Technical: packets are only sent to Refunct slots with the setting on, at max 1 per second. The send-rate slowly decreases with the number of players, making it so there are never more than 10 packets per second in total for this in the end (which only occurs if there are 10+ players).) - You can now connect to the same slot as someone else, and buttons/platforms/cubes in the main gamemode will be synced! You will also still be able to see each-other.
### Mod: - Starting from v1.3.0 generated games, you can only join games with the *exact* correct mod version. If you log in with another version, the mod will show which version you need (bottom-left and top-right). All previous versions are available in the releases tab.
### Options & Gameplay: - Added "Ascend" trap. ☁️ - Added option to have only gameplay-traps.
### Fixes: - Go-mode in UT now shows correctly. If you have enough grass and (one of the following) - if your goal is known and you can reach it. - if your goal is unknown and you have been to your final location. - When connecting, it now shows that it is still connecting instead of pretending it worked. - Removed a jump from logic that was very tight (22-1 -> 22-2).

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.1.5
entry.content:
Other players' items are now visible in the world: they show as the Archipelago logo on the warp pads, tinted by what they are. Pads can sort their rewards by type, connecting on Linux works out of the box, and the post-boss softlock that has been on the known-issues list since v0.1.2 is fixed.
If you are on v0.1.4.1, this is the release that replaces it. v0.1.4.1 shipped Windows only and was never promoted; v0.1.5 is a complete pair again, on every platform.
Thanks to everyone in the Discord who kept reporting things, and to the people of the [Majora's Mask: Recompiled AP Randomizer](https://github.com/RecompRando/MMRecompRando) for the logo mesh.
### Downloads
- **Windows:** `ctr-archipelago-v0.1.5-windows-x86.zip` (contains everything) - **Steam Deck / Linux:** `ctr-archipelago-v0.1.5-linux-x86.tar.gz` - **Hosts and players:** `ctr.apworld` and `Crash.Team.Racing.yaml` are attached separately - **Debugging a crash?** `ctr_native_ap.debug` (Linux) and `ctr_native_ap.exe.debug` (Windows) hold the debug symbols, each matched to this exact build. The Windows exe is stripped from this release on, which is why its symbols now ship separately too.
📖 [Setup guide](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/main/SETUP.md) ([as shipped](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/blob/v0.1.5/SETUP.md)). **Update the client and the apworld together, they are a pair.**
### New
- **Items belonging to other players now show as the Archipelago logo on warp pads**, tinted by classification so you can tell progression from filler at a glance. ([#124](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/124)) - **Warp pads can group what they are offering by reward type** instead of cycling one mixed pile: trophies and podium rungs in one slot, relic tiers in another, tokens and gems and crystals in the third. Set `warp_pad_item_display` in your YAML; the old behaviour is still there as `one_pile`. ([#59](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/59)) - **Hints for a shuffled warp pad now name the physical pad you have to drive into**, not just the destination. ([#52](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/52)) - **Item name groups**, so hints and commands can ask for a whole category instead of one exact item name. ([#167](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/167)) - **Boss garages and the Oxide door tell you what they want** instead of just refusing to open. ([#24](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/24)) - **The title screen tells you when a newer release is out**, once, in one orange line, with the detail under OPTIONS then Connection. Turn it off with `update_check = false` in `config.ini`. ([#150](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/150)) - **F11 toggles fullscreen**, matching upstream. Right Alt plus Enter and Left Alt plus Enter both still work. ([#143](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/143)) - **Gem cups no longer appear on the warp pads that are open right at the start.** Reaching a gem cup now always takes some progression first, so an early lucky pad can no longer hand you the strongest checks in sphere one. ([#149](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/149), caught reversed in draft review by Stef) - Audio and a set of small standalone fixes were picked up from upstream ctr-native this cycle. ([#121](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/121), [#123](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/123))
### Fixed
- **Beating a boss while holding no received Keys no longer softlocks the hub.** The first-key spawn set a driving freeze that only the Aku Aku greeting released, and the AP flow had already skipped that greeting. On the known-issues list since v0.1.2. ([#51](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/51)) - **Linux: connecting to archipelago.gg no longer fails with a certificate error on distros that keep their trust store somewhere unexpected.** ([#170](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/170)) - **The pause screen stopped showing CTR tokens you never received.** Arena crystals light for received Purple Tokens only, and the per-colour counts match the printed totals. ([#142](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/142)) - **A failed connection says what went wrong.** A dead address now reads "Cannot reach <host>, retrying" after about nine seconds instead of "Connecting..." forever. ([#146](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/146)) - **A seed generated by a newer apworld no longer sends a GOAL it cannot judge.** The client says so in the feed and stands down. ([#163](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/163)) - **The boss door's requirement line no longer draws on top of the challenge name**, and it now also shows how many trophies you hold. ([#24](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/24)) - **The item marker is shaded and spins with the other prizes** instead of sitting as a flat, fixed cut-out. ([#124](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/124)) - **The update notice sits clear of the title banner and the menu** instead of across them. ([#150](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/150)) - More retail-blind NULL dereferences are guarded, continuing the v0.1.4 sweep. ([#137](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/137)) - `ctr-ap.log` stopped claiming it banked wumpa it actually discarded, and stopped repeating the same reachability line verbatim. ([#144](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/144)) - **The music hitch at track change is gone.** ([#48](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/48))
### Known issues
- **Linux: the pre-race intro flyby renders from inside the track.** Near-black frames and flat slabs for the length of the flyby, then everything is correct the moment the countdown view takes over. Cosmetic, the racing view is unaffected. ([#138](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/138)) - **After a long spell offline, reconnecting can pause the game for about ten seconds on the intro screen** while it catches up on everything it missed. It does recover on its own; let it finish. - **Brief audio dropouts can happen when the hub streams a new region in, and when you move the window.** Not new in this release, and not the track-change hitch above; this one comes from how audio is tied to the main loop and is being worked on for a later release.
### Testing
Verified in game on the exact shipped builds, on Windows and on the Steam Deck: fullscreen on all three bindings and mid-race, both warp pad display modes including a no-regression pass on the old one, the arena token display and a first-time arena win while holding received tokens, the connection failure and recovery path, the boss win at zero received Keys that used to softlock, the update notice firing and staying silent when it should, the newer-schema stand-down, a deliberate pool-exhaustion attempt, and a full session of track changes listening for the audio hitch.
The item marker and the boss door advert placement were verified in game again on the polish build after their fixes.
Logic changes passed all ten checks of the Archipelago index fuzz matrix on the exact `ctr.apworld` shipped here, 14,000 generations, zero failures.
Not verified in game: nothing in this release is claimed above without a matrix item behind it.
### Next
0.2.0 is the content wave: all sixteen characters playable in Adventure as multiworld unlocks, staged stat and boost systems, and the location supply to pay for them. No dates, hobby project honesty applies.

entry.title: Nine Sols v0.6.2
entry.content:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/NineSolsArchipelagoRandomizer?tab=readme-ov-file#installation).
- Universal Tracker map page auto-tabbing: - If you auto-tabbed to the world_map page by opening the in-game Teleport menu, closing the menu / resuming the game will now auto-tab back to the previous map page. - Auto-tabbing for the skill_tree page has been removed. - Added a "Randomize Robe Color" setting, which changes Yi's robe's color on every room transition (inspired by the Tunic randomizer) - The save menu now shows "X locations checked" on each save slot above the playtime - The pause menu now shows how many seals are required for Eigong, Lady E and Prison above the console - Ruyi's message when trying to walk out the "jammed" FSP door now has an additional sentence to explicitly mention the Teleport menu - Talking to a non-FSP Shanhai before repairing the FSP one will now post an on-screen reminder that you can't ask for their chips before repairing the FSP one - Buying a chip from a Shanhai will finally actually deduct 400 jin from the player, in addition to checking the corresponding AP location - In the vanilla game, you could get a 'pity' Limitless Realm segment with basic combat tutorials if you died very early (many of us never saw this). The randomizer will now actively disable this segment, since its trigger conditions make no sense in rando, and it can be particularly annoying for death link players. `vanilla` logic: - "Cortex Center - Caves Middle Left" now allows CS and CL instead of CS and Nymph: instead of hacking the ropes to lower them, you can CL up to the one tiny rope that's already exposed `medium` logic: - "AF (Depths) - Lower Level" to "Under Lower Left Exit" now allows SR and T-dashes - "OW: Enemy Gauntlet Room" now allows using Cloud Piercer S/X on the shielded beetle instead of CS `ledge_storage` logic: - "AF (Depths) - Lower Left Exit" to "Climb to Root Node" previously required AD setup for LS, but T-dash setup is enough, so AD is no longer required - "ED (Passages): Above Pink Pool Left Of Root Node" and "ED (Passages): Far Left Rooms" can now be reached without TCK by triple jumping up to "Outside Tianshou Arena" then continuing up and left to the platforms above the left pink pool (i.e. doing the vanilla route to Tianshou backwards). This route uses (LG + CL + AD) to reach the first location, then an additional (bow hover or SR or CS-dash) to get to the second location. - "GoS (East) - Stone Carvings" to "Upper Exit" is now in logic with only LG because you can wall slide up the obstacle after T-dash setup - "IW - Above Frogs" to "Upper Right Statue" now allows not just triple jumping, but also wall sliding after CL setup, AD setup, or (T-dash setup and Swift Runner) - "TRC: Above Sol Statue" is now in logic with bow hover and LS vault - "Yinglong Canal - Farmland Markings" to "Above Egg Cave" previously required SR to get into the room where you wall slide without losing LS, now it also allows AD or bow hover

entry.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas v0.5.0
entry.content:
## New: - End of the Line is now another goal (*Return to Los Santos*) - Submission sliders - every submission now has an option to change its length. Choose how many checks each activity sends instead of grinding each one to the end.
## Changes: - `GTASAClient.exe` is gone - there is no need to download a separate `.exe` anymore, the client is now bundled with `gta_sa.apworld` and will appear in the Archipelago Launcher on install - Collectible blips now work differently - checking a collectible and loading an older save will return the blip for it. Recollecting them does not send a new check and only removes the blip.
## Fixes: - Fixed saving/loading storing and restoring AP progress incorrectly - Fixed items duplicating when loaded into an older save/new game - Spraying tags after loading an older save will correctly send checks. - Fixed client losing checks while server is disconnected. - Fixed mission blockers being stored in the game's save file.
## Notes: Although **Return to Los Santos** is another region now, there is no new content besides the missions. This release focused almost solely on making the mod functional again.

entry.title: Zuma Deluxe v0.2.0b0
entry.content:
Beta Release for a Archipelago of Zuma Deluxe
A playable version of the randomizer for Zuma Deluxe, still changes to come.
# Last Changes and Fixes ## Changes - When conecting to a game with the Zuma Deluxe Client it will unlock all _Stages_ in **Adventure Mode** allowing you to play any of the 12 temples from a fresh file. - Changed the basic names for items and some locations. - Added groups for items and locations (in Details will be a link for a list of them) . - Added icon in the archipelago client list. - Remade how Useful Items get calculated. - Some Yaml option like coins are now by amount and not percentage ## Fixes - Solved some looping issues that appeared with new pointers. - Corrected the amount of points detected by making chains. - Removed instakill from Rush (more in Filler Items Segments). - Shift Color doesnt generate fake balls anymore (low tested). - No more coins in Space. # Filler Items - Filler items are stackable at a higger count of 120 for instant items, or a duration of a minute for the long ones. - Rush now only doubles the speed of the level, with a duration of 5 seconds. - Color Shift has a duration of 10 seconds. - Get a Break has a duration of 10 seconds.
# Details Some details and explanations in [Game Page](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/en_Zuma_Deluxe.md) and some instruccions in [Setup Page](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/setup_en.md). List on Groups in [Group List](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/en_Zuma_Deluxe_groups.md)
# Know Issues Some know stuff planned for the future: - Filler items still has a effect even paused, there is no solution for that yet. - The Client will get better icons clearer details on unlocked areas and remaining checks. - This is included for both modes, and locations. - New Options on yaml are not yet implemented or connected, like sanitys.
# Remainders You need to have the Zuma Deluxe Client and the Zuma Deluxe game open at the same time to play
If you connect while you have a level open in Zuma go back to the menu.
If the game is not found it probably is the language of it
To keep track of locations use universal tracker
When entering a map, always use the new game, it might not recognize the mode otherwise
Deathlink accelerates the game into a own death.
Any question, Bug or idea, feel free to ask on the discord channel for the game. # **_Have Fun_**

entry.title: Idle Loops v0.4.2
entry.content:
## Idle Loops AP 0.4.2 ## #### "I have no control over the versioning scheme i chose this is a major release despite being versioned as a patch" ####
### APWorld: ### - Rewrote everything for options, and as such: - Options! - Toggles for location types - Set max level per location type - Goal based defaults (That are reasonable and playtested this time!) - (Probably should have been presets) - You can assume the new features below also have options to enable/disable them. - Added "Mana Logic" for Z1, i.e. AP knows exactly (well, underestimates) how much mana/gold you can get and what locations are possible - This let me turn off the heavy handed previous logic and now playthroughs of Z1 actually feel different! - Added a "Shop" to Z1/3 to buy checks for ramping gold costs - Respect Vanilla skill requirements for actions (i.e. Heal The Sick's "Unlocked at 12 Magic") - Unsupported additional option to also respect progress bar requirements, it's all implemented and working i just don't want complaints about Fill Errors or how close to vanilla it feels - Make Mana Reduction actions a requirement for what they reduce - Logically guarantee 10k mana from Z1 into Z2 - Require Glasses to be in Z1 - Add a second Glasses to the pool (you start the loop with Glasses if you have both) - Batch Wild Mana and Herbs 10x - Added a "Nothing" filler item - Added Gamespeed, Stat Exp and Skill Exp mults, both global and as items. (No skill exp item it would feel bad to spend time leveling something then get an item that would have sped it up by 10%) - Generally improved logic all around
### Client: ### - Also rewrote everything but for no reason - That's a lie things are properly laid out now i have a build process and everything - Colourful message log - Corrected colours on Lloyd's fork's dark mode so these colours align with other AP clients and Strength is Red again. - Redid scouting properly (compared to the very minimal original), largely a code difference but they're colourful now (and are placed in every relevant tooltip) - This feels like retreading the above but did your eyes gloss over 'Added a "Shop"'? That needed me to figure out how to inject actions into the game! - Another thing that would have been way easier if i forked the game rather than a client mod. - Added a tooltip to the "AP log" title displaying received non-action items - Fixed starting items not having an effect the first loop after connecting
And a whole lot of internal changes, optimizations and improvements (as implied by rewriting everything) that aren't really user facing so i didn't want to turn them into a patch note.
